POPULATION.corpus_view: rules-src/checks/<ORG>/*.yaml — AUTHORED view, 1 file == 1 rule id. NOT rules/ (shipped, per package) and NOT rules-legacy/ (~3.8x).

column_population.definition: (rule, foreign dataset, COLUMN, role) quadruples read by a Population-B rule out of a foreign dataset. ⚠ a DIFFERENT population from the predecessor's 487 (rule, foreign dataset) dependency rows.

resolution.granularity: QUAD; resolved if ANY shipped package yielded a core or NOT_IN_IG

mixed_across_packages.definition: one (rule, dataset, column, role) quad whose `core` DIFFERS between the IG packages the rule ships under

partition.definition: Population-B rules, bucketed by the LOOSEST `core` tier at which the rule has an OVER-FIRE SITE — a column read through a leaf that is TRUE on an all-null operand (NonEmptyGuardInliner EMPTINESS / NEGATIVE_BINOPS / RELATIONSHIP_CALLS, or the predecessor's TRUE_ON_NULL verdict).

T0_NOT_IN_IG.meaning: over-fire site on a column that is NOT a Library variable of that dataset in that package — absent unless the sponsor added it

T1_OPTIONAL.meaning: over-fire site on a Perm / Cond column — MAY BE OMITTED entirely. ⚑ THIS IS THE PLAN'S OWN HYPOTHESIS AND ITS TRUE SIZE.

T2_EXPECTED.meaning: over-fire site on an Exp column — must be INCLUDED but MAY BE ALL-NULL; under EC-43/Fix #139 that is the identical operand

T3_REQUIRED_ONLY.meaning: over-fire sites exist but every one is on a Req column — needs a NON-conformant study, which CORE-000334/356 already report

T4_CANNOT_OVER_FIRE.meaning: no over-firing leaf reads any resolved foreign column

T5_UNRESOLVABLE.meaning: no foreign column resolved in any shipped package (wildcard column, dataset absent from the Library, or rule not shipped)

CONFORMANT_STUDY_OVER_FIRE_T0_T1_T2.meaning: over-fires on a study that fully conforms to its IG

CONFORMANT_STUDY_OVER_FIRE_EXCLUDING_joi.meaning: same, but a site whose role is `join_key` does not count — a missing join key is the ADJACENT unmatched-key question, not a read column

dm_repartition.question: Does the variable-level question RE-PARTITION D3's 138 DM-dependent rules that D1 moved to THEORETICAL?

by_negi_arm.definition: which NonEmptyGuardInliner arm each over-fire site belongs to (V3: the leaf verdict REUSES that pass, it is not re-derived)
